item.title: Russian missile hits Poland during Ukraine strikes as NATO scrambles jets
item.description: Poland said a Russian cruise missile was among three objects that violated its airspace early on Friday, with Prime Minister Donald Tusk saying it did not appear to be an accident when Western military exercises were taking place in the region. item.title: President Trump Posthumously Pardons Pete Rose
item.description: President Donald Trump announced Thursday that he has granted a posthumous pardon to baseball legend Pete Rose, who died in September 2024 at age 83. item.title: ICJ rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya, orders reparations
item.description: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruled on Thursday that Myanmar committed genocide against the country's Rohingya community, marking the first time the United Nations' top court has found a state responsible for genocide.
